requirements.outcome: A user can register, sign in, refresh a session, and sign out without browser token storage.
acceptance: Valid credentials create an authenticated session.
Invalid credentials are rejected without revealing account existence.
Refresh rotates the session and logout invalidates it.
Access tokens are not stored in localStorage or sessionStorage.

requirements.outcome: Coordinators can move applications only through valid, auditable lifecycle transitions.
acceptance: Interview is required before acceptance.
Rejected and accepted applications are terminal.
Every transition records actor, role, previous state, next state, time, and reason when supplied.
Profile updates cannot bypass the lifecycle.

requirements.outcome: The platform recommends only eligible, unassigned mentees and mentors with capacity.
acceptance: Only accepted, unassigned mentees are eligible.
Mentors at capacity are excluded.
Suggestions include bounded, explainable reasons.
AI may explain a deterministic decision but cannot change eligibility.

requirements.outcome: A coordinator can book an available slot and cannot create conflicting bookings.
acceptance: A future slot can be booked for an eligible mentee.
Concurrent attempts for the same slot are serialized.
A booking is distinct from a completed session log.
The booking operation supports safe retry with an idempotency key.

requirements.outcome: A valid mentoring relationship can be recorded as a session with outcomes and support flags.
acceptance: Unrelated mentor and mentee pairs are rejected.
A valid pair can create one session log for a mentoring day.
Feedback values are bounded and validated.
The session log is visible to authorized operational users.

requirements.outcome: A user can export and delete their account data through authorized self-service controls.
acceptance: The account owner can request an export.
Deletion is protected against unauthorized or demo-account mutation.
Export and deletion actions are auditable.
Exports do not include another user's private data.
